map.成本低、成型性好、缓冲性能中等。适合规则形状产品、一次性运输。环保性差，逐步受限: Low cost, easy to form, medium cushioning performance. Suited to regularly shaped products and one-way shipping. Poor environmental profile, and increasingly restricted.
map.柔软回弹好、防震抗冲击、可反复使用。适合精密电子、易碎品，成本中等。: Soft with good resilience, shock and impact resistant, reusable. Suited to precision electronics and fragile goods, at medium cost.
map.可现场发泡贴合异形产品、缓冲性能优。适合贵重精密仪器，成本较高。: Can be foamed on site to fit irregularly shaped products, with excellent cushioning. Suited to valuable precision instruments, at higher cost.
map.轻质、柔性包裹、适合不规则产品。多层叠加使用，缓冲性能随层数提升。: Lightweight, flexible wrapping for irregular products. Used in several layers, with cushioning improving as the number of layers increases.
map.环保可回收、承重好、适合规则工业品。缓冲性低于泡沫类，需配合结构设计。: Recyclable and environmentally friendly, good load bearing, suited to regular industrial products. Cushioning is below that of foams, so it must be combined with structural design.
map.脆值 G 反映产品抗冲击能力：电子元器件 40-60g、家电 60-80g、普通: The fragility value G reflects a product’s impact resistance: electronic components 40-60 g, home appliances 60-80 g, ordinary industrial products 80-120 g. The lower the G value the more fragile the product, and the thicker the cushioning it needs.
map.本工具基于经验公式估算，实际厚度需结合材料动态缓冲曲线（CST曲线）测试确定。: This tool estimates from an empirical formula; the actual thickness must be confirmed by testing the material’s dynamic cushioning curve (CST curve).
map.厚度经验估算：建议厚度 t=材料缓冲系数 C×跌落高度 h(cm)÷产品脆值 G: Empirical thickness estimate: recommended thickness t = material cushioning coefficient C × drop height h (cm) ÷ product fragility G (g), multiplied by the weight correction factor 1 + ln(weight in kg + 1) × 0.08, and finally no less than the minimum thickness of that material; the tool also gives the total cushion layer thickness (twice the single-side thickness) and the static stress.

map.脆值分级与能力校验：G<50 为极易碎、50~80 易碎、80~120 普通、≥: Fragility grading and capability check: G below 50 is extremely fragile, 50 to 80 fragile, 80 to 120 ordinary, and 120 or above impact resistant; when the computed thickness exceeds the maximum thickness of that material, the result warns that it exceeds the capability of a single material, and you should switch to a material with a lower cushioning coefficient or use a combined cushioning design.

map.重量修正系数=1+ln(3+1)×0.08=1.1109。基础厚度 C×h÷G：: Weight correction factor = 1 + ln(3 + 1) × 0.08 = 1.1109. Base thickness C × h ÷ G: EPS 3.2 × 80 ÷ 60 = 4.2667 cm, EPE 2.6 × 80 ÷ 60 = 3.4667 cm, PU 2.2 × 80 ÷ 60 = 2.9333 cm, bubble wrap 3.8 × 80 ÷ 60 = 5.0667 cm, molded pulp 4.0 × 80 ÷ 60 = 5.3333 cm. After applying the correction factor, the recommended thickness is: EPS 4.74 cm (total cushion layer 9.5 cm), EPE 3.85 cm (7.7 cm), PU 3.26 cm (6.5 cm), bubble wrap 5.63 cm (15 layers at 0.4 cm per layer), molded pulp 5.92 cm — the last exceeds its maximum thickness of 5.0 cm and is judged beyond the capability of a single material. Static stress, using the recommended contact area max(3 × 0.01, 0.02) = 0.03 m² (300 cm²), is 3 ÷ 300 = 0.0100 kg/cm². A product fragility of 60 g counts as fragile. Switching to an EPS solution for 10 kg, a 120 cm drop and fragility 40 g: base 9.6 cm × 1.1918 = 11.44 cm, far above the EPS maximum of 8.0 cm, so PU or combined cushioning is required.
map.静应力算出来很小，这个数可靠吗？: The static stress came out very small — is that figure reliable?
map.工具按建议接触面积=max(重量×0.01, 0.02) m² 估算（3 kg: The tool estimates the recommended contact area as max(weight × 0.01, 0.02) m² (3 kg → 0.03 m², that is 300 cm²), and static stress = weight (kg) ÷ contact area (cm²). This is a recommended empirical value rather than the product’s actual load-bearing area; if the contact area of the product base is smaller than the estimate, static stress rises markedly and may exceed the material’s cushioning range, so a formal design should substitute the measured load-bearing area.
map.这个经验公式能替代缓冲曲线设计吗？: Can this empirical formula replace cushion curve design?
map.不能。t=C×h÷G 把材料的动态缓冲特性压缩成单一系数，只适合初步选料、比价与: No. t = C × h ÷ G compresses the dynamic cushioning behaviour of a material into a single coefficient and suits only preliminary material selection, price comparison and feasibility judgement. Formal cushioning package design should use the material’s dynamic cushioning curve (maximum acceleration versus static stress curve), read off the required thickness at the intersection of the target fragility G and the static stress, and verify it with drop tests; the results of this tool have not been drop-verified and should not be used directly as the basis for mass production packaging.
